build_attention_layer: build a cross-attention layer with configurable heads, qk norm, and rotary embeddings for diffusion models
swap_attention_processor: swap the attention processor on an Attention module to use xformers, sliced, or flash attention
fuse_attention_projections: fuse the query, key, and value projection layers into a single linear layer for faster inference
create_ip_adapter_processor: create an IP-Adapter attention processor to inject image embeddings into cross-attention with configurable scaling
build_joint_attention_processor: build a joint attention processor for SD3-like models that concatenates sample and context projections before attention
